Comments: The PD parameters of mortgage, revolving and loans performed well in 2026Q1. Due to the loan restructure in Chile revolving, the loan default behaviour cannot be appropriately tracked in the portfolio. The restructured loans are refinanced by term loans. That's why revolving and term loans are combined and tested together. The PDs of Chile revolving and term loans showed overestimation between 2017 to 2023. However, the estimate PD converged to the realized PD in the recent quarters. The low realized default rate between 2020 to 2023 is attributed to government reliefs during the pandemic. As the impact of the government programs diminish, we observe the default rate trending upward. Note: Since the ECL of revolving accounts with zero balance were calculated separately out of ECL production. The zero balance account adjustment has been included in the estimate PD.
